items.title: Unit 5 · Story
items.prompt: Listen and choose the word.
items.storyText: Hi, I'm Dale Duck. That is my father. He likes to bake cakes. This is my mother. She likes to make quilts. When she sees a crocodile, she makes a loud quack! That is my brother. He's a chick. He takes a bath with his toy rocket. This is my family. One, two, three. I love my family, and they love me.
items.why: In “Meet My Family”, you hear: This is my mother. The missing word is “this”.
items.hint: Listen to this sentence again. Look at the story picture.
items.sourceLabel: Oxford Phonics World 4, Unit 5, p.51 · Titi narration of the supplied textbook text
